items.question: What preparation must be completed before performing the auspicious-day rite with scattering offering?
items.inference: The verse orders adornment before the auspicious-day rite accompanied by scattering offering.
uncertainties: puṇyāhaṃ may be accusative object or adverbial; vikirakṣepapūrvakam modifies it.
items.plain_english: After adorning, perform the auspicious day preceded by scattering offering.
